messages.subject: Infrastructure & Energy Transition Executive | ESG, Stakeholder Strategy & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear ODM Partners Team,

Your executive-search focus across infrastructure, renewable energy and impact investing is highly relevant to my background at the intersection of natural resources, energy transition and stakeholder leadership.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy and executive communications, including governance around major renewable-energy and battery-storage investments.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where infrastructure or energy-transition strategy depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline, responsible development and coordinated execution. I am internationally mobile for suitable appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
